### Riza Berkan, Ph.D.

Founder, President

Riza Berkan is a scientist and technology entrepreneur with decades of experience spanning artificial intelligence, nuclear engineering, and physics. He is the founder or co-founder of several technology companies, including OLMapp, 1A1 Inc., exClone Inc, Epoch Wires Ltd, and hakia Inc. He is the author of the book Fuzzy Systems Design Principles (IEEE Press, 1997) and a contributor to Computational Web Intelligence (World Scientific, 2004). He has 100s of academic publications most of which are accessible through Google Scholar. His intellectual property portfolio includes multiple patents spanning natural language processing systems and superconductive wire manufacturing. He worked at U.S. National Laboratories including Oak Ridge X-10, Y-12, Los Alamos, and Savannah River Plant, and held senior roles in nuclear criticality safety across multiple DOE facilities. He has a Ph.D degree in nuclear engineering from the University of Tennessee, and B.S. in physics from Hacettepe University.
